resources.string: This app does not upload your health data to a cloud service, does not include ads, and does not share data with third parties.

OpenWatch is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. It is not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment from a qualified healthcare professional.
OpenWatch writes to Health Connect what a device you paired recorded, and reads only what a sync needs. Each type needs your permission, and you can take it back in Health Connect at any time.
